exposure: physical developmental indicators of infants (e.g., height)
cohort: The study included 88 preterm neonates with suspected necrotizing enterocolitis (NEC) and 30 preterm neonates in a control group.
finding: The birth of a newborn from the 3rd-4th pregnancy increased the risk of NEC development in preterm infants, and infants with confirmed NEC were found to have a statistically significant greater height.
mod_finding: No significant differences were found regarding the mode and type of delivery in the development of NEC.
